name: Intense Espresso
description: A concentrated shot of pure coffee with a thick layer of crema. Perfect for a morning energy boost.

name: Horizon Burger
description: 200g of premium beef, melted cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, and our secret house sauce on brioche pan.

name: Caprese Sandwich
description: Fresh tomato slices, melted mozzarella, and basil leaves with a touch of pesto on artisanal ciabatta bread.

name: Tres Leches Cake
description: Spongy sponge cake soaked in our traditional three milks mix, decorated with a light layer of meringue and cinnamon.

name: Supreme Cappuccino
description: Perfect balance between espresso, steamed milk, and a generous layer of milk foam, dusted with cocoa.

name: Crispy BBQ Burger
description: Grilled beef, breaded onion rings, American cheese, and our irresistible smoky barbecue sauce.

name: Chicken and Avocado Sandwich
description: Shredded chicken breast, fresh avocado slices, light mayonnaise, and organic lettuce on whole wheat multi-cereal bread.

name: Passion Fruit Cheesecake
description: Crispy cookie base with a smooth cream cheese filling, topped with a bright and tangy pure passion fruit pulp glaze.

name: Iced Vanilla Latte
description: Espresso combined with cold milk, premium vanilla syrup, and ice cubes. Ideal to refresh your afternoon.

name: Real Veggie Burger
description: Homemade patty made of quinoa and lentils, fresh spinach, tomato, and avocado cream on a classic burger bun.

name: Classic Triple Sandwich
description: The afternoon essential: perfect layers of avocado, fresh tomato, and hard-boiled egg with a touch of homemade mayonnaise.

name: Blueberry Muffin
description: Small moist muffin packed with fresh blueberries that burst in the oven, with a hint of vanilla essence.

name: Intense Americano
description: Our classic espresso diluted with hot water to prolong the enjoyment of its woody notes.

name: Ham and Cheese Croissant
description: Pure butter puff pastry croissant filled with local ham and melted Edam cheese in the oven.

name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
description: For chocolate lovers: layers of moist cocoa sponge cake filled and covered with a thick artisanal fudge.
